messages:
Marta: Quick heads-up — the biweekly release train window for next cycle needs a small shift due to the regional holiday on Friday. Proposing we move the cutoff +24h to accommodate RC testing in EMEA. :calendar:

Ava: Sounds fine to me, what's the new cutoff timestamp?

Marta: New cutoff will be 2026-06-08 17:00 UTC (was 2026-06-07 17:00). That gives QA an extra business day. Please target changelog PRs and version bumps to land before that.

Diego: Noted. I'll take the server/runtime version bump for redwood-inference and inference-runtime. Any specific semver guidance?

Marta: Keep it minimal — patch bumps where possible. If you'd like a minor for the runtime, call it out in the PR description and tag @Ava for approval.

Sunita: Changelog requirements? Short one-line bullet per PR?

Marta: Yep — one-liners plus a one-sentence context if it's user-visible. Use the changelog template in docs/release/CHANGELOG_TEMPLATE.md.

Jon: Heads up: I have a feature branch that needs a cherry-pick into the release branch for a hotfix. What's the target release branch name after the shift?

Marta: The train will use release/2026.06 after the move. If you need to cherry-pick, do something like:
```
# from your branch
git fetch origin
git checkout -b hotfix-2026-06 origin/release/2026.06
git cherry-pick <commit-sha>
git push origin hotfix-2026-06
```
Mention @Lia for merge once CI passes.

Lia: Can review cherry-picks. Also add `release-note: yes` label if it impacts API or behavior.

Diego: I'll open the version bump PRs now and add a changelog entry. ETA ~2h.

Marta: Awesome. Two operational notes: 1) Canary window will be delayed by the same 24h, so Dedicated pool scaling config won't roll until after canary passes. 2) If you have long-running migrations, flag them now; we might defer to the next train.

opsbot: :bell: Release train slot updated — cutoff changed to 2026-06-08 17:00 UTC. Canary scheduled for 2026-06-09 09:00 UTC. Automated reminders set.

Sunita: Quick question — does this change affect the release calendar entry everyone subscribes to?

Marta: Yes, I've updated the shared calendar and pinned the new event in #eng-releases. If anyone's still seeing the old time, refresh and remove cached copies.

Ava: I'll nudge folks in product and docs to sync changelog wording.

Jon: Cherry-pick PR up: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-server/pull/3421 — pinging @Lia for review.

Lia: Reviewing now. Small test flake — rerunning CI.

Diego: Bump PRs: inference-runtime -> v1.12.1 (#678), redwood-server -> v0.9.3 (#679). Both include changelog lines.

Marta: Thank you all. If any merge conflicts arise with the release branch after the shift, drop them here and we'll coordinate morning sync. :thumbsup:

Ava: Ack. I'll follow up if product requests any wording changes.

Lia: CI passed, merged hotfix.

Marta: Closing loop — cutoff change finalized, calendar updated, canary scheduled. Thanks team.
